about_the_game:
Season pass of will allow you to get a lot of valuable rewards:

  • Themed and camouflage and motifs;
  • Tools and components to improve your gear;
  • Reset Essences;
  • Additional Stlye Cases;
  • Season Crates and more.

Note!
  • This Season Pass can only be purchased ONCE per character;
  • All rewards are personal;
  • All rewards will be activated automatically upon receipt. If this has not happened, rewards can be found on your Personal Warehouse;
  • These rewards are not cross-platform and can only be used on Steam;
  • These rewards can only be granted to the same Steam account that was used to made the purchase. If you have some issues, contact the EXBO Support;
  • EXBO may update, replace, or remove in-game content at any time.
